{{Quote|Your Highness, I don't, I don't feel...|This rebel, to Princess Leia Organa, as he transformed into a rakghoul|<ref name="Rebellion 15">[[Rebellion 15|''Rebellion'' 15]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''member''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike force sent to recover an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] weapon. During the mission, he was attacked by a [[rakghoul]] and later [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|transformed]] into one. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] witnessed firsthand how he changed into a rakghoul.
